inclusions.text: Pickup from your Cairo or Giza hotel between 8 and 9 AM
inclusions.source: The tour begins with a pickup from your Cairo or Giza hotel between 8 and 9 AM.
An English-speaking Egyptologist guide accompanies you throughout; this is a private tour, so the pace and the questions are yours to set.
The return transfer to your hotel is in the early evening, with Cairo's traffic between the bazaar and the western banks of the Nile a small price for the timing.
